Blueprint.description: A crafting blueprint: a `CraftingBlueprintRecord` Record under `crafting/blueprints/crafting`.

categoryGuid.description: The GUID of the category Record, `null` without one.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `BP_CRAFT_behr_lmg_ballistic_01_mag`.

craftTimeSeconds.description: The craft time of the first tier in seconds, `null` without one.

defaultAvailable.description:
Whether the blueprint is one the player has by default
(`CraftingGlobalParams.defaultBlueprintSelection`).

dismantle.description:
What dismantling the produced item returns, `null` without a produced item, for an item
that cannot be dismantled, and unless the Build holds exactly one dismantle process.

ingredients.description:
The ingredients of the first tier in stored order, derived from `tiers`: a selection is
flattened depth first, so its count, quantity multipliers and quality modifiers are not
represented here.

key.description: The blueprint key, the Record name.

producedItemGuid.description:
The GUID of the entity the blueprint produces, `null` without one or for a Reference to
a Record the DataForge lacks.

tiers.description:
Every tier in stored order with its craft time and its costs, selections kept as
`select` lines. The first one is the tier `craftTimeSeconds` and `ingredients` describe.

BlueprintCategory.description:
A blueprint category: a `BlueprintCategoryRecord` Record under `crafting/blueprintcategories`,
the target of the `categoryGuid` of a blueprint.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `FPSArmours`.

name.description: The name; the Record holds no field for one, so the key is `null`.

BlueprintDismantle.description:
What dismantling the item of a blueprint returns: a link to the process and the tier.

The item returns the share `efficiency` of the process of the costs of the tier `tierIndex`,
except the resources in `craftingGlobal.dismantleExcludedResourceGuids`. A `select` is not
resolved and the quantity multiplier is not applied; these are assumptions, not verified
against the game.

tierIndex.description:
The index into `tiers` of the tier whose costs are returned, `null` for a blueprint
without a tier.

BlueprintPool.description:
A blueprint pool: a `BlueprintPoolRecord` under `crafting/blueprintrewards` that a reward
draws a blueprint from.

A source gives the blueprint of an entry with the chance of the source times the weight of the
entry over `totalWeight`.

className.description: The Record name without its type.

rewardSources.description: The places that reward a blueprint of the pool, found through their Reference to it.

totalWeight.description: The sum of the positive weights of the entries.

BlueprintTier.description: One tier of a blueprint: its craft time and its costs.

craftTimeSeconds.description: The craft time of the tier in whole seconds, `null` without one.

mandatory.description: The mandatory cost, usually a `select`; `null` without one.

optional.description: The optional costs in stored order.

changeNumber.description: The Perforce change number the Build was made from.

publicPatch.description:
The public patch version, e.g. `4.7.2`, from the RSI Launcher log line with the same
change number; `null` when the log has none.

Commodity.description:
A commodity: an `EntityClassDefinition` Record under `entities/commodities` or a
`ResourceType` Record a blueprint ingredient uses that no commodity Record carries.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `Gold`.

description.description:
The description, from the entity's display parameters or, without one, from the
`ResourceType` Record of the commodity.

displayType.description:
The display type of the purchasable parameters, e.g. `@items_commodities_type_metal`;
without a key for a `ResourceType` entry.

guid.description: The GUID of the Record; for a `ResourceType` entry the GUID of the `ResourceType`.

subtypeGuid.description:
The GUID of the `ResourceType` Record the commodity's default composition holds first,
`null` without one. The `resourceGuid` of an ingredient equals the
`subtypeGuid` of exactly one commodity.

typeGuid.description:
The GUID of the `ResourceTypeGroup` Record that directly lists the `ResourceType`, `null`
without a `ResourceType` or a group.

CostLine.description:
One cost of a tier: a selection ("choose n") of costs, a resource line or an item line.

The fields of the other lines are `null`, or empty for `options` and `modifiers`.

compositionInclusion.description:
The option of `CraftingCostContext_ResultCompositionInclusion`, e.g. `Include`; `null`
without one. A closed set the game may extend.

count.description:
A `select`: how many options the player chooses, `null` when the Record holds no count.
Fewer than `options` offers means the player may leave options out.

itemGuid.description: An `item`: the GUID of the entity.

kind.description:
What the line is: `select`, `resource` or `item`. A closed set; a reader maps an unknown
value to nothing.

minQuality.description: A `resource` or `item`: the minimum quality, `null` without one.

modifiers.description:
The gameplay properties the line's quality scales
(`CraftingCostContext_ResultGameplayPropertyModifiers`).

options.description: A `select`: the options in stored order.

quantityMultiplier.description: The `CraftingCostContext_QuantityMultiplier` factor of the line, `null` without one.

quantityScu.description: A `resource`: the quantity in standard cargo units (SCU), before the quantity multiplier.

quantityUnits.description: An `item`: the number of units, before the quantity multiplier.

resourceGuid.description: A `resource`: the GUID of the `ResourceType` Record.

slot.description: A `select`: the debug name of the slot, `null` without one.

slotKey.description: A `select`: the localisation key of the slot name, `null` without one or for a placeholder.

CraftingGlobal.description: The `CraftingGlobalParams` Records, merged: what applies to every dismantle.

dismantleExcludedItemGuids.description: The entities that cannot be dismantled; their blueprints have no `dismantle`.

DismantleProcess.description:
A generic dismantle process: a `CraftingBlueprintRecord` under `crafting/blueprints/dismantle`
whose process is a `GenericCraftingProcess_Dismantle`.

className.description: The Record name without its type.

efficiency.description:
The share of the costs a dismantled item returns, 0 to 1, `null` when the Record holds
none.

timeSeconds.description: The dismantle time in whole seconds, `null` when the Record holds none.

GameplayProperty.description:
A gameplay property definition: a `CraftingGameplayPropertyDef` Record under
`crafting/craftedproperties`, the target of the `propertyGuid` of a modifier.

className.description: The Record name without its type.

name.description: The name of the property; a placeholder key leaves `en` and `de` `null`.

Guid.description: A GUID as canonical lower-case UUID text.

Ingredient.description: One ingredient line of a blueprint: a resource or an item with its quantity.

itemGuid.description: The GUID of the entity of an item line, `null` for a resource line.

minQuality.description: The minimum quality the ingredient must have, `null` without one.

quantityScu.description: The quantity of a resource line in standard cargo units (SCU), `null` for an item line.

quantityUnits.description: The quantity of an item line in units, `null` for a resource line.

resourceGuid.description: The GUID of the `ResourceType` Record of a resource line, `null` for an item line.

slot.description: The debug name of the slot the ingredient fills, `null` without one.

slotKey.description: The localisation key of the slot name, `null` without one or for a placeholder.

Item.description: An item: an `EntityClassDefinition` Record under `entities/scitem` or `entities/legacyitems`.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `POWR_ACAS_S01_Lumen`.

displayType.description: The display type of the purchasable parameters, e.g. `@item_DisplayType_PowerPlant`.

itemClass.description:
The item class from the `Class:` line of the English description, `null` for another
value or without that line. Today one of `Civilian`, `Competition`, `Industrial`,
`Military` and `Stealth`; the schema keeps a string, as a new value is additive.

manufacturerGuid.description:
The GUID of the manufacturer the Reference `AttachDef.Manufacturer` links to, `null` for
a null Reference.

mass.description: The mass in kilograms of the physics controller, `null` without one.

playability.description:
Who the item is for, `null` when no rule applies. Today one of `player`, `mission` and
`special`; the schema keeps a string, as a new value is additive.

subType.description: The item subtype of `AttachDef.SubType`, e.g. `Power`, `null` without one.

tags.description: The words of `AttachDef.Tags`, in stored order.

type.description: The item type of `AttachDef.Type`, e.g. `PowerPlant`, `null` without one.

KindCompleteness.description: Whether a kind holds every Record of the Build or only those a Filter selected.

oneOf.description: Every Record of the kind is listed; one missing from the catalog was removed from the game.
Only the Records the Filter selected are listed.

LocalisedText.description:
A text the game localises: its localisation key and the resolved English and German texts,
as the language's `global.ini` stores them with the escape `\n` decoded to a line feed.

de.description:
The German text, `null` for no key, a placeholder key, or a key the German `global.ini`
lacks or holds empty.

en.description:
The English text, `null` for no key, a placeholder key, or a key the English `global.ini`
lacks or holds empty.

key.description: The localisation key, e.g. `@manufacturer_NameACAS`, `null` when it is unknown.

LocationOverride.description: A distribution that replaces the default one at a location.

distribution.description: The distribution at the location, `null` when the Record holds none.

locationGuid.description: The GUID of the location Record, `null` for a null Reference.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `ACAS` for `SCItemManufacturer.ACAS`.

code.description: The manufacturer code, e.g. `ACAS`, `null` when it cannot be read.

PoolEntry.description: One entry of a blueprint pool.

blueprintGuid.description: The GUID of the blueprint, `null` for a null Reference.

weight.description: The weight of the entry among the pool's, `null` when the Record holds none.

PropertyModifier.description: A gameplay property of the crafted item with the ranges that scale it by quality.

propertyGuid.description: The GUID of the `gameplayProperties` entry, `null` for a null Reference.

kind.description:
The struct of the distribution, e.g. `CraftingQualityDistributionNormal`. A closed set the
game may extend.

QualityDistribution.description:
A quality distribution Record under `crafting/qualitydistribution`: the default distribution
of a source or the list of its location overrides.

className.description: The Record name without its type.

distribution.description: The distribution of a `CraftingQualityDistributionRecord`, `null` for an override Record.

overrides.description: The overrides of a `CraftingQualityLocationOverrideRecord`, empty for a default Record.

ResourceGroup.description:
A resource group: a `ResourceTypeGroup` Record under `resourcetypedatabase`, the type the
`typeGuid` of a commodity points at.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `Metal`.

name.description: The name, from `displayName`; a placeholder key leaves `en` and `de` `null`.

parentGuid.description: The GUID of the group that lists this group in its `groups`, `null` for a top-level group.

RewardSource.description:
A place that rewards a blueprint of a pool with a chance: a `BlueprintRewards` result of a
contract.

chance.description: The chance that the reward is given, 0 to 1, `null` when the Record holds none.

contractId.description: The `id` of the nearest enclosing struct that has one, e.g. the contract.

recordGuid.description: The GUID of the Record that holds the reward.

recordPath.description: The record path of that Record, without `.xml`.

Ship.description:
A ship or ground vehicle: an `EntityClassDefinition` Record under `entities/spaceships` or
`entities/groundvehicles`.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `AEGS_Avenger_Titan`.

description.description: The description, from `vehicleDescription` of the vehicle parameters.

manufacturerGuid.description:
The GUID of the manufacturer the Reference `manufacturer` links to, `null` for a null
Reference.

name.description: The name, from `vehicleName` of the vehicle parameters.

playability.description:
Who the ship is for, `null` when no rule applies. Today one of `player`, `ai`, `mission`
and `special`; the schema keeps a string, as a new value is additive.

vehicleDefinition.description: The path of the vehicle definition XML, `null` without one.

archiveModified.description: The modification time of the Archive file, UTC in RFC 3339 form, `null` when unknown.

archiveSize.description: The size of the Archive file in bytes.

build.description: The Build from the Channel's build manifest, `null` when it is unknown.

channel.description: The Channel: the name of the folder holding the Archive, `null` when there is none.

exportedAt.description: When the catalog was written, UTC in RFC 3339 form.

toolVersion.description: The version of P4K-Extractor that wrote the catalog.

ValueRange.description: One linear range of a modifier: the value at the quality `startQuality` and at `endQuality`.

atEnd.description: The modifier at the end quality, `null` when the Record holds none.

atStart.description: The modifier at the start quality, `null` when the Record holds none.

endQuality.description: The quality the range ends at, `null` when the Record holds none.

kind.description:
`multiplier` when the values are factors, `additive` when they are summands. A closed set;
a reader maps an unknown value to nothing.

startQuality.description: The quality the range starts at, `null` when the Record holds none.

description: The Basetool catalog: the game data the basetool's P4K import reads.

blueprintCategories.description: The blueprint categories, ordered by GUID.

blueprintPools.description: The blueprint pools with the places that reward them, ordered by GUID.

completeness.description: Whether each kind is a complete snapshot of the Build.

craftingGlobal.description: The global crafting parameters that apply to every dismantle.

dismantleProcesses.description: The dismantle processes, ordered by GUID.

gameplayProperties.description: The gameplay property definitions the quality modifiers refer to, ordered by GUID.

qualityDistributions.description: The quality distributions and their location overrides, ordered by GUID.

resourceGroups.description: The resource groups, ordered by GUID.

schemaVersion.description: The version of the catalog shape; an import rejects a version it does not know.

source.description: The Archive and Build the catalog was made from.

title: P4K-Extractor Basetool catalog
